name: Akada Salon
description: Akada Salon has been creating modern, beautiful hair since 1997 — precision cuts, lived-in color and balayage, and polished styling from an experienced team led by salon manager Cara.

hero.title: Modern hair. Since 1997.
hero.subtitle: Precision cuts, lived-in color, balayage, and effortless styling from a salon with over 25 years of experience. Book your appointment today.

stylists.name: Cara
stylists.title: Salon Manager
stylists.bio: Cara manages Akada Salon and makes sure every guest feels welcome from the moment they walk in. With a team built on more than 25 years of salon experience, she helps every client find the right stylist, service, and look.

reviews.name: Laura B.
reviews.text: I've been coming to Akada for years and they never disappoint. My balayage is always perfect.

reviews.name: Michelle T.
reviews.text: Cara and the team are so welcoming. Booking is easy and every appointment feels effortless.

reviews.name: Daniel R.
reviews.text: Consistently great cuts. You can tell they've been doing this a long time.

reviews.name: Sophie K.
reviews.text: Beautiful salon, beautiful color, and genuinely lovely people. Highly recommend Akada.
